config.note: EXPLORATORY PILOT for EXP-002, run before the owner's freeze. Tuning streams only: policies are tuned on tuning streams 0-49 and evaluated on tuning streams 50-99; evaluation streams (role 1) are never generated. Purpose: runtime per run, projected full-matrix time, spread of paired differences between streams (seed-count adequacy) and degenerate cells or grid-edge optima. Not evidence and never reported as a finding.
